children: European private equity firm Eurazeo has opened its first Middle East office in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM).

The Abu Dhabi office will serve as a regional hub for Eurazeo's activities across the Middle East, strengthening its engagement with institutional investors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds and strategic partners.

The office will be led by Adrien Pinelli, Managing Director in Eurazeo's Investor Relations team, and reflects the firm's strategy to deepen relationships with investors and entrepreneurs across key global markets.
(Writing by Brinda Darasha; editing by Seban Scaria)

title: Eurazeo opens first Middle East office in Abu Dhabi
